import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df):
    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) or df.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input must be a pandas DataFrame with at least one column.")

    result_df = df.copy(deep=True)
    last_col = result_df.columns[-1]

    imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="mean")
    imputed_values = imputer.fit_transform(result_df[[last_col]])
    result_df[last_col] = imputed_values.ravel()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    sns.boxplot(y=result_df[last_col], ax=ax)
    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.set_title(f"Boxplot of {last_col}")

    return result_df, ax
